description: Step 1 of sending money. Quotes a payout of amount USDT from your balance to an address in any coin with payout=true in list_assets: returns preview_id, to_amount (what the recipient gets), fee and expires_at. Nothing is sent yet and the quote is free; check the address and amounts, then call create_payout with preview_id before expires_at. An invalid address answers invalid_address.

amount.description: USDT to take from your balance.

amount_atomic.description: Amount in the smallest units of the asset (alternative to amount). Give exactly one of amount and amount_atomic.

destination_asset_id.description: Coin the recipient gets. Public asset code from list_assets (its asset_id field), e.g. "usdt" (USDT TRC20), "btc", "eth", "xmr", "usdc_eth".

destination_network.description: Network of the destination coin: the network field from list_assets.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. The same key returns the same result instead of a duplicate (safe retries); generated when omitted.

name: preview_payout
title: Quote a payout (send crypto)
